_ai_assisted: AI-assisted: protocol structure regenerated with Codex under Edu decisions for #137, then reviewed and rewritten with Claude against guia_tratamientos_vigilancia_urgencia.pdf; human review by Edu pending.
_integration_status: Activated for confirmed numerical findings. Immediate clinical-priority entry before measurement confirmation remains a separate owner integration; no numerical finding automatically establishes urgency.

route.source: Prototype flow composition [P]: no published primary source.

w_red_flags.text: Are any of these present in either eye: a new visual-field gap, central distortion, needed correction beyond what is available, sudden vision loss, severe eye pain, or severe headache with neurological signs?
w_red_flags.source: Gew et al., SANS expert consensus, Eye, 2026 [6] (doi:10.1038/s41433-026-04651-6): acute visual field loss and central visual distortion as key risks. NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf). Their use as in-flight urgency criteria, and sudden visual loss, intense eye pain or headache with neurological signs: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

w_escalate.source: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

w_concern.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), printed pp. 4 and 13, and Gew et al., SANS expert consensus, Eye, 2026 [6] (doi:10.1038/s41433-026-04651-6): TRT increase and Frisen grade as indications for post-flight lumbar puncture. Use as an in-flight priority-review trigger: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

w_priority_review.text: Ask the crew medical officer for priority medical review of the concerning finding, with each eye's corrected acuity, OCT and visual fields when available. A concerning number alone does not establish a medical urgency.
w_priority_review.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), printed pp. 4, 6-9 and 13: in-flight acuity, OCT and visual-field testing, more when clinically indicated. Priority review: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

w_review_outcome.text: Answer once the clinician has completed the priority review; until then stay on this step. Has the clinician declared a medical urgency?
w_review_outcome.source: Clinician-held escalation after a priority review: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

w_notify.text: Notify the crew medical officer. Together, agree on your check-ups and who is responsible for them.
w_notify.source: NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3] (https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/faq-the-real-story-about-astronaut-health-care-in-space/): crews keep regular contact with their doctors. Notification step: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

w_acuity.text: With the clinician, compare each eye's corrected acuity with your personal baseline using Check-in results; review OCT and visual fields when available. Select I can't if results are missing or invalid: they must not be treated as normal.
w_acuity.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), printed pp. 6-9: visual acuity, OCT and visual fields tested in flight, more when clinically indicated. Check-in results reviewed instead of new measurements (Edu decision, #137); 'not evaluable' rule: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

w_missing_data.text: Not evaluable: a missing or invalid eye test is not a normal result, and without OCT the structural surveillance is incomplete. Agree with the clinician how to complete the tests.
w_missing_data.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), printed p. 6: OCT is the in-flight measure of optic disc edema. 'Not evaluable' rule: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

w_symptoms.text: Do you have mild, gradual difficulty focusing or reading?
w_symptoms.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), printed p. 5, and Gew et al., SANS expert consensus, Eye, 2026 [6] (doi:10.1038/s41433-026-04651-6): hyperopic shift with reduced near vision as the reported symptom. Use as the watch criterion: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

w_correction.text: Use only your prescribed correction: space anticipation glasses or the prescribed adjustment. Select Done if it restores your focus, although clearer focus does not prove swelling has resolved; select I can't only if no available correction is enough.
w_correction.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), printed pp. 9 and 12: optical correction of increasing power, several lens pairs flown. Gew et al., SANS expert consensus, Eye, 2026 [6] (doi:10.1038/s41433-026-04651-6): space anticipation glasses are the only established measure. Urgency when no available correction is enough: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

w_end.text: Keep the agreed check-ups and follow sleep and habitat procedures. LBNP, thigh cuffs and supplements are under research, and acetazolamide or other drugs have no established SANS efficacy: never start them, pressure manipulation or invasive eye procedures from this app.
w_end.source: NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), printed pp. 12-13: LBNP, thigh cuffs and B vitamins under study, no medication proven, acetazolamide limits; printed p. 2: impaired sleep and CO2 as possible risk factors. Gew et al., SANS expert consensus, Eye, 2026 [6] (doi:10.1038/s41433-026-04651-6): no established treatment beyond glasses.

u_stop.text: Stop risky tasks and EVA, and alert the crew medical officer immediately. Record when symptoms began and which eye is affected; do not wait for OCT.
u_stop.source: Stop-task and record-onset response: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

u_local.text: Activate the on-board medical lead for immediate ocular and neurological assessment; the clinician decides care and restrictions. Do not assume every acute visual problem is SANS, and glasses that compensate do not replace the assessment of a visual loss.
u_local.source: Immediate ocular and neurological assessment without assuming SANS: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

u_env.source: NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3] (https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/faq-the-real-story-about-astronaut-health-care-in-space/): flight surgeons follow each crew during the mission. NASA, Hazard: Distance From Earth [7] (https://www.nasa.gov/hrp/hazard-distance-from-earth/): delayed Earth support at Mars. Routing by environment: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

u_moon.text: Care continues on board or in the habitat; this alert does not trigger an evacuation. The clinician evaluates any transfer according to vehicle and resources and decides whether to request Earth support.
u_moon.source: Moon routing (care on board, transfer evaluated by the clinician, no Earth contact named): Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

u_earth.text: Send the case to the flight surgeons for remote medical support; this app does not send the message itself. Do not wait for the reply: on-board care continues under the local emergency protocol.
u_earth.source: NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3] (https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/faq-the-real-story-about-astronaut-health-care-in-space/): flight surgeons follow each crew during the mission. NASA, Hazard: Distance From Earth [7] (https://www.nasa.gov/hrp/hazard-distance-from-earth/): up to 20 minutes one-way delay at Mars, crews act with minimal Earth support. NASA, Mars Communications Disruption and Delay (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/mars-communications-disruption-and-delay.pdf).

u_handover.text: Confirm that a clinician has reviewed this episode and accepted responsibility for ongoing care. Select Done only then; otherwise keep this task active and stay assisted.
u_handover.source: Urgency held until clinician acceptance; crew acknowledgement, not authenticated sign-off (Edu decision, #137): Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.

u_end.text: Clinical review and accepted handover are recorded; this is not a cure or EVA clearance. No rescue drug is established for SANS: the clinician treats the diagnosis found, sets restrictions and assesses any feasible return or transfer.
u_end.source: Gew et al., SANS expert consensus, Eye, 2026 [6] (doi:10.1038/s41433-026-04651-6) and NASA OCHMO-MTB-001, SANS, 2024 [5] (https://www.nasa.gov/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/ochmo-mtb-001-sans.pdf), printed p. 12: no proven medication or established rescue treatment. NASA, The Real Story About Astronaut Health Care in Space [3] (https://www.nasa.gov/missions/station/faq-the-real-story-about-astronaut-health-care-in-space/): return in the crew's spacecraft if an emergency requires it. EVA and closing rules: Team triage proposal [P]: no published primary source.
